bullets.title: The Concussion Repair Manual
bullets.note:
From Amazon: The Concussion Repair Manual is written as a user’s guide for
those suffering after head traumas and those that support them. It is one-part
“textbook,” packed with the leading research on medical technologies for
healing the injured brain, and one-part “workbook,” offering a step-by-step
method for making and tracking a personalized recovery regimen. As more and
more high profile athletes come forward to share their stories of invisible
suffering after head injuries, we as a culture are finally acknowledging this
silent epidemic.**

restorative sleep.**
